note: Generated by frontend/src/lib/scoring/golden.ts (npm run golden). Do not edit by hand. Inputs are synthetic and exist to pin arithmetic, not to resemble a patient.

contributions.because: Held four numbers in order on the first try.

cases.name: ema-full-confidence
cases.about: From 50, a raw of 100 at full confidence moves the level a quarter of the way: 62.5.

cases.name: ema-half-confidence
cases.about: Half the confidence, half the step: 56.25.

cases.name: migrated-profile
cases.about: A profile saved before the engine: level 60, no history. Matches the old 0.6 → 0.7 rule.

cases.name: clamped-and-rejected
cases.about: Out-of-range values are clamped; zero confidence is skipped and produces no reading.

cases.name: baseline-and-sd-warmup
cases.about: Baseline is the level for the first 3, then the trailing mean. SD is 12 for the first 5, then measured.

cases.name: identical-raws-sd-floor
cases.about: Seven identical scores give a measured SD of 0; the floor of 3 keeps velocity finite.

cases.name: gated-early-drop
cases.about: A collapse on the third session is still `stable`: domain confidence is 0.25, under the 0.35 gate.

cases.name: two-consecutive-decline
cases.about: Stable around 70, then a sustained fall. The first low reading is `decline` but raises nothing; the second raises the alert.

cases.name: single-rule
cases.about: The same series under SINGLE: the alert fires one session sooner, and ordinary noise raises a false watch earlier on.

cases.name: cusum-slow-drift
cases.about: A slow slide of about 0.9 points a session, under CUSUM: the sum crosses h / 2 (watch), then h (decline).

cases.name: one-bad-day
cases.about: A single poor session in a stable run: `decline` for that reading, no alert, and the run resets.

cases.name: improving
cases.about: A step up registers as `improving` and never alerts.

cases.name: window-rollover
cases.about: Forty sessions: only the last 30 raws are kept, and the baseline follows them.

cases.name: gating-off
cases.about: With the gate at 0, the early collapse in `gated-early-drop` is reported and alerts.

cases.name: many-targets
cases.about: One visit touching several domains and a sub-signal: each keeps its own state.

cases.name: low-confidence-sessions
cases.about: Abandoned visits at 0.1 confidence barely move the level but still count as observations.
